run_f_gold: run f_gold to compute the maximum number of composite numbers that sum to n
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple input parameters to verify correct composite number split results
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to replace the TOFILL placeholder f_filled with an equivalent implementation
review_f_gold: review f_gold algorithm that uses modulo 4 remainder logic to split n into maximum composite numbers
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which returns the max count of composite numbers summing to n or -1 if impossible
